phase_name: Remove skill-todo, Deregister It, and Redeploy to a Clean Tree

objectives.description: Delete skills/skill-todo/SKILL.md and the now-empty directory
Run audit-deletion-references.sh skill-todo and capture hit list for Phase 3
Confirm regenerated .claude-extensions.json no longer lists skill-todo/SKILL.md

deviations.description: manifest.json's provides.scripts array needed an entry for test-todo-archived-projects-scan.sh (created in Phase 1)
deviations.reason: Plan gap, not an intentional skip: Phase 1 created the new test file but its Files-to-modify list did not include a manifest.json provides.scripts registration. Without it the manifest-driven deploy copier never actually deploys the file (confirmed: suite-classification.data's new row deployed fine via a different mechanism, but the .sh file itself did not), which fails gate 5's category-parity scan with 'Missing scripts: scripts/tests/test-todo-archived-projects-scan.sh'. Added the missing entry to manifest.json's provides.scripts array in this phase and redeployed; gate 5 is now green.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added a second manifest.json edit beyond the planned skills[] removal, to register the Phase-1-created test file's provides.scripts entry)*

notes: Full verify-deploy.sh run reports 5-7 of 44 checks FAIL depending on the run, none traced to this task's edits. Gates 4, 20, 29 are confirmed pre-existing/out-of-scope (unrelated files, committed under unrelated tasks, clean git status). Gates 21/23 are flaky inside the full run but report zero violations when invoked standalone immediately after -- attributed to this heavily shared, concurrently-loaded dev environment (6+ other claude agent processes observed). Gate 8's 2 'NEW' suite failures (test-deploy-propagation.sh, test-gate-registry-resolution.sh) are confirmed unrelated to skill-todo/todo.md (neither file mentions either string); their root causes are a documented pre-existing 'two-engine defect' (test-deploy-propagation.sh's own header) and a cascade from the same pre-existing gate-29 typescript violation (test-gate-registry-resolution.sh case32). The other 5 gate-8 failures are already tracked in known-failures.txt as pre-existing needs-owner rows. All of Phase 2's own in-scope criteria pass: SKILL.md absent from source store and deployed tree, manifest.json clean, gate 5 (manifest parity) PASS, gate 13 (orphan detection) PASS, and both test-todo-move-pair-staging.sh (24/24, three surviving site shapes + negative controls) and test-todo-archived-projects-scan.sh (6/6) pass standalone. Recorded in full via issue-record.sh (class: verification gap, severity: minor).
